get_block_data: load and return cached Minecraft block data from the block_data pickle file
get_colour_data: load and return cached Minecraft block colour data from the color_data pickle file
get_block_property_data: load and return cached Minecraft block property data from the block_property_data pickle file
get_mob_property_data: load and return cached Minecraft mob property data from the mob_property_data pickle file
get_bid_to_colours: build a mapping from block IDs to their colours by combining block and colour data
get_schematics: load Minecraft schematics from the schematics directory with optional random sampling limit
